title: Data Pipeline
description: End-to-end ETL pipeline that fetches data from external APIs, transforms and enriches records with AI, validates quality through human review, and loads approved data into production.

modules.label: Data Ingestion
modules.description: Fetches raw data from configured API endpoints, parses responses, and stores raw files for downstream processing.

outputs.name: raw_files
outputs.description: Parsed JSON files stored in data/raw/
outputs.format: JSON, one file per API response

modules.label: Data Transformation
modules.description: Normalizes field formats, removes duplicates, and enriches records with AI-generated metadata.

modules.label: Validation
modules.description: Validates data schema and quality, then routes records through human review before approval.

modules.label: Loading
modules.description: Stages validated data and promotes it to the production database after final checks.

nodes.label: fetch_api
nodes.description: Calls configured external APIs and captures raw JSON responses.

nodes.label: deduplicate
nodes.description: Removes exact and near-duplicate records using title and identifier matching.

nodes.label: enrich_fields
nodes.description: Uses an LLM to generate missing metadata fields like categories and summaries.

nodes.label: schema_check
nodes.description: Validates each record against the expected JSON schema. Invalid records are sent back for re-normalization or marked as unfixable.

nodes.label: quality_score
nodes.description: AI-generated quality score based on completeness, consistency, and accuracy heuristics.

nodes.label: human_review
nodes.description: Human reviewer inspects flagged records and decides to approve, rework, or reject.

nodes.label: load_production
nodes.description: Final promotion to production database after staging validation passes.

details.docs: Fetches data from configured API endpoints

edges.label: raw files
edges.description: Raw JSON files are handed off from ingestion to transformation for normalization.

edges.label: enriched
edges.description: AI-enriched records are passed to validation for schema and quality checks.

edges.label: schema invalid
edges.description: Records failing schema validation are sent back to normalization for correction.

edges.label: needs rework
edges.description: Human reviewer sends records back to normalization when quality issues need manual correction.
